findings.title: Title Screen Tagline Contrast
findings.problem: The tagline text blends into the bright, sunset-colored background.
findings.why: It reduces immediate readability and causes the player to miss the game's pitch upon loading.
findings.fix: Apply a subtle text stroke or change the color to a slightly darker, opaque white/grey to ensure legibility against the busy horizon.

findings.title: Arena Radar 'Alive' Indicator
findings.problem: The radar display lacks a visible sweep or scanning animation, appearing static.
findings.why: It reads as a 'broken' or 'inactive' icon rather than a high-tech instrument, lacking the dynamic feel of the game.
findings.fix: Add a subtle, rotating line or sweep across the radar face to indicate that the system is live and scanning, even with no enemies present.

findings.title: Condition Panel Data Hierarchy
findings.where: Arena Screen (and Road), top right 'CONDITION' panel
findings.problem: The health numbers (e.g., '4/4') are small and crowded next to the labels ('FRONT').
findings.why: In combat, the player needs to scan health rapidly. Small, low-emphasis numbers create a bottleneck for reading car status.
findings.fix: Increase the font size or weight of the health numbers to make them the primary data point in the panel.

findings.title: Constructor Slot Selection Highlight
findings.problem: The list of slots lacks a visual cursor or highlight for the currently selected row.
findings.why: Without visual feedback, it is unclear which specific weapon or armor slot the player is currently editing or viewing.
findings.fix: Add a distinct background highlighter (color or border) to the currently selected row in the slot list.

findings.title: City Screen Status Stats
findings.where: City Screen, bottom left 'Duster' info box
findings.problem: The car stats ('0 armour - 0 mounted') are small and run together next to the larger warning text.
findings.why: The stats are harder to read than the warning, creating a disjointed visual hierarchy for the car's condition.
findings.fix: Increase the font size of the stats or bold them, and/or separate them into distinct lines to improve readability.
